boundaries: No uniqueness claim for ordinary right equivalence without a nonzero scalar.
No uniqueness claim over arbitrary non-algebraically-closed fields.
No uniqueness claim for degenerate potentials or for one-puncture surfaces.
The C-based GLS statements are not silently promoted to arbitrary-field representation-type theorems; the needed cycle-necessity implication is proved directly.
Generic uncountable-field existence is not used to cover countable algebraically closed fields.
Imported published theorems are applied at checked hypotheses, not re-proved in full generality.
Finite genera, characteristic and exponent checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.
No author-issued erratum, external human peer review, formal machine proof, novelty or priority is claimed.
